summary: Internet-facing host runs an HTTP service and an exposed MySQL port; the sole recorded finding is CISA KEV-listed with CVSS 9.8, and no compensating controls were observed.

recommended_actions.action: Patch or mitigate the KEV-listed HTTP finding and confirm the service must remain internet-facing
recommended_actions.reason: CVE-1999-9001 carries CVSS 9.8, is listed in the CISA KEV catalog, and the host is internet-facing with no WAF or TLS observed.

recommended_actions.action: Restrict the MySQL service from internet exposure or place it behind authentication
recommended_actions.reason: A database port reachable from the internet with no compensating control invites brute force and data exposure even without a recorded finding.

correlations.observation: The HTTP finding is the only recorded vulnerability, but the exposed database port compounds the blast radius of any compromise.

uncertainties: No authenticated validation or exploit attempt was performed.
Whether the MySQL service must remain externally reachable is not recorded.
